# cursor 2026.11.20 — idle tail with a task row under the framed box

`idle-task-edited.txt` is transcribed, not captured raw. Its last rows are the idle tail that vlist's
`builder-cursor` and `tester-cursor` seats (cursor-agent, Grok 4.7) showed after each finished turn
on 2026-11-20 (20:34Z and 21:13Z). Each time, TeamCLI read the screen as `done (screen not recognised)`.
The rows, top to bottom:
- the box's `▄` frame row;
- `→ Add a follow-up`, the empty input placeholder;
- the `▀` frame row;
- `1 task`, the background-task count;
- the status row `Grok 4.7 256K High · 51.3% · 3 files edited … Run Everything`;
- the workspace line.

The frame and status rows have the widths a live pane draws, with the border one column wider than
the status row. The status and workspace rows were taken from the live panes, read-only through
herdr. The transcript rows above the box are placeholders.
